name: jev.nonstream.schema-extra-constraint-request-from-ir
description: A schema property carrying a constraint beyond the synthesized projection (multipleOf) is not the exact synthesized shape: it is skipped with one N-JEV-6 loss while supported properties reconstruct normally.

system.text:
State text.

Answer the structured questions that follow as a single JSON object. Keys MUST be exactly the question IDs given in the user message; values MUST match each question's type: noul answers are numbers in [0,1], choice answers are one of the listed option names, score answers are one of the listed level numbers. Output raw JSON only: no prose, no markdown fences.

expected_losses.detail: N-JEV-6: schema constraint beyond the synthesized projection
